results.notes: SUBSTRATE all correct (mechanically verified from quranic-corpus.json). 2:30 objection: atajʿalu (2:30:11 INTG+IMPF|2MS) fīhā man yufsidu (14 IMPF|3MS) wa yasfiku (16:2 IMPF|3MS) vs the angels' self-description wa naḥnu (18:2 PRON|1P) nusabbiḥu (19 IMPF|1P) nuqaddisu (21:2 IMPF|1P) — the we/they contrast is textually present. Reply is assertion not counter-argument: innī aʿlamu (25 IMPF|1S) mā lā taʿlamūna (28 IMPF|2MP). 2:31 pivot to demonstration: ʿallama (PERF VF:2) Ādama-l-asmāʾa, then imperative anbiʾūnī (2MP) + in kuntum ṣādiqīn. 2:32 failure: lā ʿilma lanā illā mā ʿallamtanā. 2:33 closes the ring (a-lam aqul lakum innī aʿlamu). Verse order is literally claim(30)->test(31)->failure(32)->vindication(33). Not a disguised frequency-count. IMPOSED CHECK: not imposed — RECOVERED tafsir. al-Jalalayn 2:31 glosses fa-qāla as 'tabkītan' and reads in kuntum ṣādiqīn as 'that you are worthier of the khilāfah'; al-Muyassar 2:31 same ('awlā bil-istikhlāf'); al-Ṭabarī 2:33 frames the name-test as exposing the angels' ignorance of God's tadbīr; al-Jalalayn 2:33 reads mā kuntum taktumūn as their concealed claim of superiority.
